fields.statement: genesis.md core loop: the work contract. Agents work on an accepted change set (`ready` requires it). The contract: read with `slice`; write back only revisions within the change set's intent; anything outside it becomes a new change set linked `discovered-from`, or a question; finish with `genesis land` as the last commit. This replaces "Then `genesis propose`" (propose stays for a draft the agent opens itself); change-sets.md agrees.
